items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I don't remember Ned. You don't remember Ned.

ctx.x: And another fellow, Ned. I never heard that's his last name or first name. Do you remember anything about him? Ned. Ned, you see. Came after Bolden and there was some who played maybe a little bit with Frankie Doosman for a while. I don't even hear all those stories. I don't know what's the name.
I don't remember Ned. You don't remember Ned. But I remember Joe Johnson and, oh, who was the other guy?
Was Andrew Kimball very early in the way?
